description: Canonical, evidence-based registry of LensWord products and use cases. Generated from a direct repository audit (see repo-audit.md). Consumed by VitePress navigation (SurfaceChooser.vue) and the product-aware changelog/release-transparency system (#281/#282). Treat as the single source of truth for product IDs, names, status, and changelog identity — do not redefine products elsewhere. Adding a product means adding one entry here; scripts/changelog/generate.py, the SurfaceChooser component, and the changelog fragment validator all read from this file rather than hardcoding a product list.

products.name: Web Application
products.purpose: Browser-based vocabulary learning and review interface.
products.releaseChannelNote: Docker image built in CI but never pushed to a registry (push: false).

products.name: Desktop Application
products.purpose: Tauri 2 desktop shell wrapping the web frontend, remote-only (no bundled backend or database).
products.statusNote: No git tag or GitHub Release has ever been created. README states explicitly: 'No release has been published yet.'
ciCoverage: check (ubuntu-latest, macos-latest only — no Windows leg in ci.yml)
products.releaseChannel: GitHub Releases (draft, unsigned by default) via .github/workflows/release.yml on v* tags

products.name: Browser Extension
products.purpose: Chrome MV3 extension to capture selected words from any webpage into a LensWord group.
install: manual 'Load unpacked' in chrome://extensions — no build step
products.statusNote: Functional but not published to the Chrome Web Store; zero CI coverage. v1 scope hardcoded to Spanish, no translations.
artifactTypes: unpacked source (sideload zip only, no store package built by CI)

products.name: MCP Server
products.purpose: Model Context Protocol server exposing LensWord actions to MCP clients (Claude, Codex, Cursor, etc.) over stdio by default, or Streamable HTTP when explicitly enabled.
install: pip install from source (setuptools build backend) — entry point 'lensword-mcp'
products.statusNote: Not published to PyPI. No CI coverage despite having its own pytest suite. Remote HTTP transport is double-gated off by default (REMOTE_MCP_ENABLED on the backend + LENSWORD_MCP_TRANSPORT/LENSWORD_MCP_REMOTE_ENABLED on the MCP process) and has no live interop test against a real third-party MCP host.
artifactTypes: sdist/wheel (built locally only, never published to PyPI)

products.name: Local CLI
products.purpose: Command-line entry point ('lensword') distinct from the MCP server, with add/explain/diagnose/review/import-context subcommands.
install: pip install from source — entry point 'lensword'
products.statusNote: import-context is read-only/offline by design (never writes, never contacts the backend, redacts secrets, 50,000-char default cap). Other subcommands need the same backend env vars as the MCP server.
artifactTypes: sdist/wheel (shares apps/mcp's package with mcp-server — same tag prefix, not versioned separately)

products.name: Backend (API)
products.purpose: Shared FastAPI server implementing auth, groups, words, review scheduling (SM-2/FSRS), MnemoLab AI, reminders, and the MCP invocation boundary. Not an independently distributed product.
products.releaseChannelNote: Docker image built in CI but never pushed to a registry (push: false).
products.versionTagPrefixNote: Not independently versioned or released — see docs/internal/repo-audit.md. Its changelog entries are folded into whichever product(s) the change actually affects (usually all of them, since every public product depends on it), not published under a separate server-api tag until it is confirmed to have its own release lifecycle.

useCases.label: Learn and review vocabulary in a browser
Run LensWord for yourself or a team
limitations: notifications are log-only, no real email/push provider
rate limiting is per-instance, not shared across a multi-instance deployment

useCases.label: Use LensWord as a desktop application
prerequisites: a running remote server (remote-only, no bundled backend)
limitations: no installer has ever been published
CI builds macOS and Linux only, no Windows leg
native notifications are unit-tested but never observed on a real OS

useCases.label: Capture selected words from a webpage
prerequisites: API URL, bearer token, group ID entered manually
limitations: not published to the Chrome Web Store

useCases.label: Connect Claude, Codex, Cursor, or another MCP client
prerequisites: LENSWORD_API_URL, LENSWORD_TOKEN, LENSWORD_MCP_REQUESTER, LENSWORD_MCP_WORKSPACE env vars
limitations: remote transport untested against a real third-party MCP host

useCases.label: Preview/import developer context through the local CLI
Configure local Ollama-powered mnemonic suggestions
prerequisites: running ollama serve with a pulled model
3 backend env vars set (ai_provider off by default)
limitations: some documented reproducible defects in docs/ai-model-verification.md

useCases.label: Verify releases, compatibility, and platform evidence
